name: stri_count_fixed
title: Count the Number of Pattern Occurrences

origin.description: Count how many times a literal pattern occurs in each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Character vector of literal patterns. An empty pattern is not supported.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: Settings for case-insensitive and overlapping search. NULL uses the defaults.
Further settings passed to stri_opts_fixed, including case_insensitive and overlap.

origin.details: The inputs are recycled to the longer length. A missing string or pattern, or an empty pattern, yields NA. An empty string with a real pattern counts as 0. Overlap advances one code point after each match. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.value: An integer vector. A missing result is NA.

translation.description: Count how many times a literal pattern occurs in each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those. An empty pattern yields NA.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict with case_insensitive and overlap.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, overrides a case-insensitive setting in opts_fixed.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: If true, count matches that share code points.

translation.details: The inputs are recycled to the longer length. A missing string or pattern, or an empty pattern, yields NA. An empty string with a real pattern counts as 0. Overlap advances one code point after each match. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. translation.value: A list of integers. A missing result is NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_count_fixed
result = stri_count_fixed("babab", "b")
print(f'stri_count_fixed("babab", "b") returns {result[0]}.')
